values.zh-CN: 可由其余向量表示判据

content.snl:
thm-hyp(list-partial(
  LA.VectorSpace(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace),
  Type.annotation(@n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Nat),
  Type.annotation(@alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Type.to(LA.Fin(n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)),
  Type.annotation(@beta@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)
), Logic.iff(LA.LinearlyDependent(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), Logic.exists-typed(@i, LA.Fin(n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), LA.RepresentableByOthers(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, alpha@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, i))))

values.zh-CN: α 线性相关当且仅当其中某一向量可由其余向量线性表示。
values.en: α is dependent iff one member is linearly represented by the remaining members.
